key_idea: The code is a length-K subsequence of every observation, so enumerate the at most C(12,6)=924 subsequences of the first string and test each against the others.
sketch: Enumerate all bitmasks of the first observation with exactly K bits, build the candidate, and check it is a subsequence of every other string with a two-pointer scan. Collect candidates in a std::set to dedupe and get lexicographic order. Complexity is about 4096*20*12 operations. Pitfalls: duplicates from different index choices, leading zeros (keep codes as strings).
